payload.title: [HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-002] Add Enqueue diagnostics panel to all execution detail pages
payload.body:
## Summary

Implement a shared **Enqueue diagnostics** region on Hermes dashboard execution detail pages so admins see persisted `errors` when `enqueueStatus` is `failed` or `partial`, with a proper empty state when status is failed but `errors` is missing, and **no panel** (or collapsed-by-default) when enqueue succeeded.

## Scope

- In scope: Schedule, HTTP trigger, and manual pipeline execution **detail** routes only (PRD non-goals exclude list views).
- In scope: Accessible region (`aria-label` or landmark), chronological rendering of entries, support for extended fields from `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-001` (exception stack, phase, code), graceful handling of malformed JSON (PRD §6).
- Out of scope: Execution list badges, Slack/email.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When `enqueueStatus ∈ { failed, partial }` and `errors` is non-null with entries, the page shows **message** and **timestamp** for each entry in chronological order; optional fields (stack, phase, `pipelineStepId`) render when present (REQ-001).
- [ ] When `enqueueStatus === failed` and `errors` is null or `[]`, the UI shows the agreed **empty state** copy (hint: legacy row / worker crash before persist) per PRD REQ-001.
- [ ] When `enqueueStatus === success`, the diagnostics region is **not shown** by default (REQ-001).
- [ ] Same shared component/pattern is used on:
  - `/dashboard/schedules/[id]/executions/[executionId]`
  - `/dashboard/http-triggers/[id]/executions/[executionId]`
  - `/dashboard/pipelines/[id]/executions/[executionId]` (manual)
    (REQ-002).
- [ ] **Partial** uses warning styling; **failed** uses error styling (PRD §5 states table).
- [ ] Component/unit tests cover: success hides panel; failed + errors renders N entries; failed + empty errors shows empty state; malformed JSON shows fallback (Vitest + React Testing Library as per app conventions).
- [ ] Follow project React rules (e.g. state/effects in hooks if client interactivity is added).

## Dependencies

- Depends on: none (consumes existing `execution.errors` shape; enriched shape from `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-001` is additive)
- Blocks: `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-004`, `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-005` (extend the same panel)

## Notes

- Reuse existing design tokens (Shadcn/Tailwind) and patterns from similar alert/detail panels in Hermes dashboard.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/hermes-enqueue-failure-diagnostics.prd.md
